name: Dire Collar, Greater
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 229
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th
Slot neck; Price 14,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
This collar functions as a dire collar, except that the animal wearing it gains the benefit of an animal growth spell for 1 minute.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, animal growth; Cost 7,000 gp
